clue.text: Goddess returned seed to island

indicators.note: something returned goes back the way it came, so the word is read from its end to its start

blocks.note: seed in the sense of a man's seminal fluid
IS is a standard abbreviation for island

explanation.surface: A goddess brings seed back to an island, like a fertility myth.
explanation.definitionFit: Nemesis is the Greek deity of retribution, punishing hubris and undeserved good fortune.

clue.text: Steal in prison

blocks.note: first meaning: a slang verb for pinch or pilfer
second meaning: British slang for a jail or police station

explanation.surface: Someone is stealing while serving time inside.
explanation.walkthrough: In British slang a police station or prison is 'the nick', and to nick something is to steal it.
explanation.definitionFit: The same slang word serves as a verb for thieving and a noun for a lock-up.

clue.text: Gambler's third high card is a club

indicators.note: third points to a single letter counted from the start of the word before it

blocks.note: the third letter of the gambler's name for themself
the ace ranks highest in many card games

explanation.surface: A card player's third top card turns out to be a club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Club' looks like the card suit to go with the high card, but it is the definition, a weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: A mace is a heavy spiked club used as a medieval weapon, a synonym in the weapon sense.

clue.text: Small little exam is most agreeable

blocks.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
wee is Scottish for little
a test is an exam

explanation.surface: A short, easy test is the nicest kind of exam.
explanation.definitionFit: Sweet can mean pleasant or nice, so its superlative describes whatever is pleasantest.

clue.text: Used fake English leather

indicators.note: a fake is a made-up version, so the word before it is rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written
E is the abbreviation for English

explanation.surface: Someone passes off second-hand imitation leather as genuine English goods.
explanation.definitionFit: Suede is leather with a napped finish, made from the underside of the skin.

clue.text: Strange pouch first found in bone

blocks.note: a sac is a pouch-like cavity in an organism
rum is British informal for odd or strange

explanation.surface: An odd pouch has been discovered inside a bone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'First' tells you the pouch goes ahead of the word for strange. 'Strange' looks like an anagram signal but here it is a synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: The sacrum is the triangular bone at the base of the spine, between the hip bones.

clue.text: A maths problem leads to breathing difficulty

indicators.note: a problem is something tangled to be worked out, so the letters get rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A maths problem so stressful that it leaves a pupil wheezing.
explanation.definitionFit: Asthma is a respiratory condition causing wheezing and shortness of breath.

clue.text: Organisation advocating community service for troubled burly actor

indicators.note: something troubled is disturbed and unsettled, so these letters are mixed up

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A troubled, beefy actor is sentenced to community service by some organisation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Community service' suggests a court sentence for the troubled actor, but it is part of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A Rotary Club is a local branch of Rotary International, a service organisation of business people doing charity work.

clue.text: Worked as a clergyman in small desert settlement

indicators.note: a settlement is a resolution or new arrangement, so the word before it is reordered

blocks.note: mini means very small
taken as written

explanation.surface: A priest served as minister in a little outpost in the desert.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Desert settlement' reads as an oasis town; 'settlement' is really the signal to rearrange the word before it.
explanation.definitionFit: To minister is to perform the duties of a church minister, serving a congregation.

clue.text: Pretend to hide something to open a door in church — it's not true

indicators.note: to hide something is to hold it out of sight inside, so one word wraps the rest
in places the item before it inside the word that follows

blocks.note: cod is British informal for sham or mock, as in cod Latin
a key opens a locked door
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Someone fakes concealing a door key in a church, but the story is false.
explanation.walkthrough: Two containers nest: the key goes into the church first, then that whole unit into the word for pretend. 'Not true' means not straight or level, as a carpenter would say.
explanation.definitionFit: Cockeyed means askew or crooked, and true in carpentry means exactly straight or aligned.

clue.text: Good man takes a container to get anti-cholesterol drug

blocks.note: a saint is a good man, abbreviated ST
taken as written
a tin is a metal container

explanation.surface: A decent fellow collects a pill box to obtain his cholesterol medicine.
explanation.definitionFit: Statins are a class of drugs prescribed to lower blood cholesterol levels.

clue.text: Speaker's money smells

indicators.note: a speaker's version is what is heard, so the word is matched by its sound, not spelling

blocks.note: cents are small coins of money

explanation.surface: A public speaker's cash has an odd odour.
explanation.definitionFit: Scents are odours or fragrances, plural nouns just like smells.

clue.text: Showing signs of pregnancy, almost vomit in an Italian cathedral

indicators.note: in sets the first item inside the place named after it

blocks.note: to retch is to heave without quite being sick
St Mark's is the great basilica in Venice

explanation.surface: A pregnant tourist with morning sickness gags inside a famous Italian church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Almost' is not cutting a letter: retching is what you do when you almost vomit.
explanation.definitionFit: Stretch marks are streaks on the skin from rapid stretching, commonly appearing on the belly during pregnancy.

clue.text: Maybe order new piece of kit for nail bar

definitions.text: piece of kit for nail bar

indicators.note: new suggests remaking something, so these letters take a fresh arrangement

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A manicure salon owner wonders whether to buy new equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: An emery board is a strip coated with abrasive grit used to file fingernails in manicures.

clue.text: Conservative entering without delay is liable to change allegiance

indicators.note: entering means going into, so one piece is put inside the other

blocks.note: Con is the abbreviation for a Conservative
instant means immediate

explanation.surface: A Tory crossing the floor swiftly is the kind to switch party.
explanation.definitionFit: Inconstant means fickle or changeable, especially unfaithful in loyalty or love.

clue.text: Setter's getting rent, so order soup

indicators.note: to order things is to arrange them, so these letters are put into a new sequence

blocks.note: the setter's is 'mine' from the setter's point of view
taken as written

explanation.surface: A landlord collects rent and so can order soup.
explanation.definitionFit: Minestrone is a thick Italian vegetable soup, often with pasta or rice.

clue.text: Tell the story of queen turning up dead

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up means the word reads from bottom to top

blocks.note: ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen
the late someone is someone who has died

explanation.surface: Recount the tale of a queen found dead.
explanation.definitionFit: To relate is to narrate or recount events, a direct synonym for telling a story.

clue.text: Prompt to hit a ball

blocks.note: first meaning: a signal for an actor to speak
second meaning: to strike a ball with the long stick in snooker or billiards

explanation.walkthrough: 'Prompt' looks like an adjective for a quick strike, but it is a noun meaning a signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a theatrical signal and a verb for striking with a snooker stick.

clue.text: Most significant Chinese leader beheaded criminal set for release

indicators.note: a leader comes at the front, so only the opening letter of the word is kept
beheading cuts off the top, so the first letter of the next word is dropped
released things are let loose, so these letters scatter into a new order

blocks.note: the first letter of the word
a thief is a criminal
taken as written

explanation.surface: A senior Chinese official is executed while an offender is freed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chinese leader' tempts you towards CH or a famous chairman; it is just the initial letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Chiefest is an old superlative of chief, meaning principal or most important.

clue.text: Warhol's letter from Greece?

indicators.note: the possessive says the word belongs to the name, sitting inside its letters

blocks.note: the three middle letters of the artist's name

explanation.surface: A query about whether Andy Warhol sent a letter from Greece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Letter' looks like correspondence posted from Greece, but it is a letter of the Greek alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: Rho is the seventeenth character of the Greek alphabet, equivalent to R.

clue.text: At the end of spring, girl gets you and me in to weed part of the garden

indicators.note: the end of a word is its final letter, so just that one is kept
in places the pair of people inside the word that follows

blocks.note: the last letter of the word
a lass is a girl
us is you and me together
to hoe is to weed with a long-handled tool

explanation.surface: In late spring, a girl recruits the two of us to weed a garden bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'At the end of spring' sounds like a date, but it means only the last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A glasshouse is a greenhouse, a glass building in a garden for growing plants.

clue.text: Mean to reject school attended by editor

indicators.note: to reject is to send back, so the combined letters are read backwards

blocks.note: Eton is the famous English public school
ED is the standard abbreviation for editor

explanation.surface: A mean-spirited editor plans to turn down a school he once attended.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mean' wants to be an adjective for nasty; it is a verb meaning signify.
explanation.definitionFit: To denote is to indicate or signify, which is what a word means.

clue.text: Wearing glasses to see something worth looking at in bed!

indicators.note: in sets the sight inside the piece of furniture named after it

blocks.note: a spectacle is an impressive sight
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone puts on specs to watch a show in bed, with a saucy hint.
explanation.walkthrough: The exclamation mark nods to the bedroom innuendo; a spectacle also echoes the spectacles themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: Bespectacled describes someone who wears spectacles, an adjective just like the phrase.

clue.text: Starts to cause a row over mate's shot at billiards

indicators.note: starts are the opening letters, so each following word gives only its first

blocks.note: the initial letter of each of these five words

explanation.surface: A billiards player's shot provokes an argument about a friend.
explanation.definitionFit: A carom is a cannon in billiards, a shot where the cue ball strikes two balls in succession.

clue.text: Icelandic leader on a Scottish island

indicators.note: a leader is at the front, so only the opening letter of the word is kept

blocks.note: the first letter of the word
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: An Icelandic chieftain lands on an island off Scotland.
explanation.walkthrough: IONA is a small island in the Inner Hebrides, famous for its early Christian abbey.
explanation.definitionFit: Iona lies off the west coast of Mull in the Inner Hebrides, so it is an example of an island off Scotland.

clue.text: Surrender territory in late December uprising

indicators.note: in says the letters lie inside the words that follow
in a down clue, rising up means the letters read from bottom to top

blocks.note: the last letter of the first word and first three of the second

explanation.surface: A government gives up land after a revolt at the end of the year.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Uprising' sounds like the rebellion that forces the surrender, but it signals a reversal.
explanation.definitionFit: To cede is to formally yield or hand over land or rights, usually to another state.

clue.text: Market place by river

blocks.note: first meaning: the huge online retailer
second meaning: the great South American waterway

explanation.surface: A market square sits beside a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Market place' reads as a town square, but it is the online shopping site.
explanation.definitionFit: The name belongs both to the internet retail giant and to the vast river in Brazil.

clue.text: Feel over-excited by unconventional sex

indicators.note: excited letters are stirred up and agitated, so they are jumbled into a new order

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone feels thrilled at the thought of unorthodox sex.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Over-excited' reads as one word, but the hyphen hides a split: 'over' is fodder and 'excited' the signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Free love is the doctrine of sexual relations without marriage or monogamy, outside convention.

clue.text: Article accepted by director in state of indecision

indicators.note: what is accepted is taken inside, so one piece is held within the other

blocks.note: the definite article
DIR is the abbreviation for director

explanation.surface: A director dithers over whether to accept a newspaper article.
explanation.definitionFit: A dither is a flustered, hesitant condition, so being in one means wavering over a choice.

clue.text: Change the name of green house gas

indicators.note: to change something is to alter its form, so these letters are reordered

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone renames a green-painted house, of all things.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is split as 'green house' to suggest a painted home; read it as greenhouse gas.
explanation.definitionFit: Methane is a potent greenhouse gas, released by cattle, landfill and gas leaks, contributing to global warming.
